consequence.statement: A configuration using the Docker provider with swarmMode is unsupported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting.
consequence.remediation: Do not use swarmMode with the Docker provider; use the Swarm provider instead.

original.statement: In v3 the Docker provider's swarmMode option is unsupported (Swarm moved to a separate Swarm provider), and configuring providers.docker.swarmMode prevents Traefik from starting.

decision.reason: [ev-c6ee7d3b73da] shows the v2 setup `providers.docker.swarmMode=true` and says "This configuration is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start". So if the operator does nothing, the upgraded Traefik will not start. That fits upgrade-blocked (an unmet configuration precondition stops the upgraded install from running), which is action-required. The remediation, to stop using swarmMode on the Docker provider and switch to the Swarm provider, matches the guide's own Remediation text.
